const LL MOD = 1000000007;

struct Matrix {
    int N;
    vector<vector<LL>> m;
    Matrix(int N) : N(N), m(N, vector<LL>(N, 0)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) m[i][i] = 1;
    }
    Matrix operator*(const Matrix& b) const {
        Matrix ret(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {

                    cans = (cans + m[i][k] * b.m[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
                ret.m[i][j] = cans;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

    cin >> n >> k;

        M[0][i] = Matrix(k+1);
        for (int j = 0; j <= k; ++j) M[0][i].m[i][j] = 1;
    }
    vector<LL> kp(100);

    int lg = 2;

        M[i][0] = Matrix(k+1);
        for (int j = 1; j < k; ++j) {
            M[i][j] = M[i-1][j-1] * M[i][j-1];
        }
        Matrix cpro(k+1);

            cpro = cpro * M[i-1][j];

    LL ret = 0;

        ret = (ret + ans.m[i][k]) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ret << endl;
    return 0;
